name: Melody Bar & Grill
facts: Melody Bar & Grill is at 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045 (Westchester), near LAX, and has been open since 1952.
Hours listed: Mon-Fri 11 AM to 1:30 AM, Sat-Sun 9 AM to 1:30 AM. Call to confirm late night.
Happy hour is 3-6 daily.
Mon: half off burgers 11-3.
Tue: $4 classic tacos, $6.99 elevated tacos and $6 margaritas.
Thu: half off sandwiches 11-3.
Fri: $3 sliders 11-3.
Weekly: karaoke, live bands, DJs, trivia and every game on the TVs.
Melody Rewards is free to join and gives 100 welcome points.
You earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip.
Referral: you and your friend each get 100 points.
Birthday bonus: 250 points once a year.
Rewards: 250 pts soft drink or Melody Fries, 500 pts $10 off, 1,000 pts free starter, 1,500 pts free entree up to $21.50.
One reward per visit and one prize per day. Rewards are never free alcohol.
A reward pass works once and expires 10 minutes after you open it.
Just Landed: 10% off your first order today with a boarding pass from a flight that landed at LAX in the last 24 hours.
Melody Approach is a free flying game with Campaign and Survival modes.
Two weekly boards (Campaign score, Survival time) reset every Monday.
Game prizes and game points are in BETA and not switched on yet; the boards are for bragging rights for now.
Once game rewards are on: 1 point per 100 game score, max 50 game points a day.
The Games Pack has Trivia, Sports Trivia, Melody Word, Melody Mix and Truth or Dare, plus the LA Scoreboard.
Football Squares: one free square per member per game, extra squares with purchase.
You order from your phone by picking a table, the bar, the patio or to go. Pay your server like normal.
Parking is free, including a free lot.
The app needs no download and has 12 languages.
Food prices in the app are from Melody's menu; drink prices are previews until Melody signs off.

How many points do I earn per dollar?
What rewards can I get and what do they cost?

qa.q: What is the address?
qa.a: Melody Bar & Grill is at 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045 (Westchester). Tap Directions in the app to open a map.

qa.q: What is your phone number?
qa.a: You can call us at (310) 670-1994, or tap Call in the app.

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: We're listed as open Mon-Fri 11 AM to 1:30 AM and Sat-Sun 9 AM to 1:30 AM. Hours can vary, so call (310) 670-1994 to confirm late at night.

qa.q: Are you open on weekends?
qa.a: Yes. Saturday and Sunday we're listed as open from 9 AM to 1:30 AM. Call (310) 670-1994 to confirm late night.

qa.q: What time does the kitchen close?
qa.a: I don't have the kitchen closing time. Please ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Is there parking?
qa.a: Yes, parking is free, including a free lot. Call (310) 670-1994 if you have questions about space.

qa.q: Can I walk from LAX?
qa.a: Yes, it's about a 15-minute walk from the LAX terminals. Melody is also about 5 minutes from LAX by car.

qa.q: When is happy hour?
qa.a: Happy hour is 3-6 every day. Show your app to your server and add your visit for points.

qa.q: What are the daily specials?
qa.a: Mon: half off burgers 11-3. Tue: $4 classic tacos, $6.99 elevated tacos and $6 margaritas. Thu: half off sandwiches 11-3. Fri: $3 sliders 11-3. Happy hour is 3-6 daily.

qa.q: What is the Monday special?
qa.a: Mondays are half off burgers, 11 to 3.

qa.q: What is the Tuesday special?
qa.a: Taco Tuesday: classic tacos are $4 each and elevated tacos are $6.99 each. Margaritas are $6 on Tuesdays.

qa.q: What is the Wednesday special?
qa.a: I don't have a Wednesday food special in the app. Weekly karaoke is listed on Wednesdays from about 10 PM, so call (310) 670-1994 to confirm.

qa.q: What is the Thursday special?
qa.a: Thursdays are half off sandwiches, 11 to 3.

qa.q: What is the Friday special?
qa.a: Fridays are $3 sliders, 11 to 3.

qa.q: What are the Taco Tuesday hours?
qa.a: Taco Tuesday runs 11 AM to midnight on Tuesdays only.

qa.q: Which tacos are the $4 ones?
qa.a: The $4 classics are Chicken, Steak, Carnitas, Dockside Fish, Shrimp, Salmon, Avocado, Beyond and Vegan Carnitas.

qa.q: What are the elevated tacos?
qa.a: Elevated tacos are $6.99 each: the Baja Shrimp Taco Melt, the Smash Burger Taco and the Sweet & Spicy Fried Chicken Taco. They're Tuesdays only.

qa.q: What entertainment do you have?
qa.a: Every week we have karaoke, live bands, DJs and trivia, and every game is on the TVs. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994 for the schedule.

qa.q: Do you show sports?
qa.a: Yes, every game is on the TVs. The app also has an LA Scoreboard with live scores for LA and California teams.

qa.q: Is there a cover charge?
qa.a: I don't have cover charge details. Please ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Do you take reservations?
qa.a: I don't have reservation details in the app. Please call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Do you do private events or catering?
qa.a: I don't have event or catering details in the app. Please call (310) 670-1994 and staff can help.

qa.q: Is there a dress code or age limit?
qa.a: I don't have those details. Please ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: How do I join Melody Rewards?
qa.a: Joining is free and takes about 10 seconds. Tap the join button in the app. You get a gold rewards card on your phone and 100 welcome points.

qa.q: What does it cost to join?
qa.a: Nothing. Melody Rewards is free, and you get 100 welcome points when you join.

qa.q: How many points do I get for joining?
qa.a: You get 100 welcome points once, when you join.

qa.q: How many points do I earn per dollar?
qa.a: You earn 10 points for every $1 spent on eligible purchases, before tip. That's 10 points per dollar.

qa.q: How do I get points for my visit?
qa.a: Tap Add my visit in the app, then snap your receipt or type the check number, total and date (today or yesterday). Once Melody's register is connected, this will happen automatically.

qa.q: Is there a limit on adding receipts?
qa.a: Yes. It's one receipt per member per day, each check can only be used once, and a check counts up to $150. Claims are checked against the restaurant's sales, and points from made-up checks are removed.

qa.q: Do tips earn points?
qa.a: No. Points are 10 per $1 before tip.

qa.q: What can I get with my points?
qa.a: 250 points: free soft drink or Melody Fries. 500: $10 off your check. 1,000: free starter (Fried Green Beans, Avocado Toast or Chicken Pot Stickers). 1,500: free entree up to $21.50. Check your rewards card for current costs.

qa.q: What does the free soft drink or Melody Fries reward cost?
qa.a: It costs 250 points. Check your rewards card in the app for the latest cost.

qa.q: How many points for $10 off?
qa.a: $10 off your check costs 500 points. Check your rewards card in the app for the latest cost.

qa.q: What is the free starter reward?
qa.a: For 1,000 points you can get a free starter: Fried Green Beans, Avocado Toast or Chicken Pot Stickers.

qa.q: What is the free entree reward?
qa.a: For 1,500 points you get a free meal: any entree up to $21.50, such as Mac & Cheese, Melody Burger, a burrito, tacos or Baby Back Ribs & Fries.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Tap Use reward and show the live pass to your server, who applies it. The points come off when you open the pass.

qa.q: How long does a reward pass last?
qa.a: A pass works once and expires 10 minutes after you open it. Your next code comes on your next visit.

qa.q: Can I use more than one reward at a time?
qa.a: No. It's one reward per visit and one prize per day, with no stacking. This covers rewards, gifts and anything won in a game.

qa.q: Can I get a free drink with alcohol?
qa.a: No. Rewards are never free alcohol.

qa.q: What does Come back tomorrow mean?
qa.a: You've already taken a prize today. You can take one prize per day, so your next one is available tomorrow (Los Angeles date).

qa.q: Do points expire or can they be transferred?
qa.a: Rewards have no cash value and can't be transferred. I don't have details on points expiring. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Are there levels or tiers?
qa.a: I don't see levels or tiers in the app. You just earn points and spend them on rewards.

qa.q: Is there a birthday reward?
qa.a: Yes, you get a bonus of 250 points once a year on your birthday.

qa.q: How does the refer a friend program work?
qa.a: Tap Text a friend on your member card to send your invite link. Your friend joins with your code and comes in, and you each get 100 points.

qa.q: When do I get my referral points?
qa.a: Referral points pay once per friend, after their first visit. Your friend gets 100 welcome points too.

qa.q: Can I enter a friend's code later?
qa.a: No. You can use one friend's code per member, entered once when you join. It can't be changed later, and you can't use your own.

qa.q: Is there a location bonus?
qa.a: Yes, a one-time +100 points. Turn on nearby alerts, then open the app with location and notifications on at least 3 different days spanning at least 7 days. It's added automatically.

qa.q: What are nearby alerts?
qa.a: They're optional. If you turn them on, the app can show a You're nearby deal when you open it within about half a mile of Melody. Nothing turns on without your tap and your phone's permission.

qa.q: How do I turn off nearby alerts?
qa.a: Tap Turn off nearby alerts in the app, or switch off Location and Notifications for the app in your phone's Settings. Points you already earned stay.

qa.q: What is the Just Landed deal?
qa.a: Just flew in? Show your boarding pass from a flight that landed at LAX in the last 24 hours and get 10% off your first order today.

qa.q: Are there limits on the Just Landed deal?
qa.a: It's one per guest per day and can't be combined with other offers.

qa.q: How do I use Just Landed?
qa.a: Tap I just landed in the app to get a code, then show your boarding pass and the code to your server. The code is good for 24 hours.

qa.q: What is Melody Approach?
qa.a: It's our free arcade flying game. You fly a plane over LA, shoot enemies, dodge fire and catch Melody's food. It has two modes: Campaign and Survival.

qa.q: How do I control the plane?
qa.a: Drag anywhere on the game and the plane glides to your finger. Tap the lightning button for a speed boost and grab the hourglass for slow-mo.

qa.q: What is Campaign mode?
qa.a: Campaign is 10 levels of about 45 seconds each, following a SoCal route from LAX. It has six boss fights (levels 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 10), then you land back at LAX.

qa.q: What is Survival mode?
qa.a: Survival has no finish line. The game keeps getting harder until your plane goes down, and your time survived is your score.

qa.q: How does damage work in the game?
qa.a: Every enemy attack is warned first. Three hits and your plane goes down. The game is over and nothing else happens.

qa.q: When do the guns turn on?
qa.a: Guns go live about 20 seconds into a flight. Beating levels and bosses (or flying longer in Survival) unlocks stronger guns, which use limited ammo. Catch ammo crates to refill.

qa.q: Can I play without fighting?
qa.a: Yes. Tap the crossed-swords button to switch to a calm flight with no combat.

qa.q: How is the game scored?
qa.a: In Campaign you're ranked by score, which you get from shooting enemies and catching food and music notes. In Survival you're ranked by the longest time survived.

qa.q: How often can I play?
qa.a: As often as you like. The game is free to play, with or without an account.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: There are two weekly boards, Campaign (by score) and Survival (by longest time), and both reset every Monday. After a flight, tap Post my score to put your score on the board. Practice flights don't count.

qa.q: What do I win in the weekly game contest?
qa.a: Right now the game is in BETA and the boards are for bragging rights only. Once prizes switch on, the top player on each weekly board may win the weekly prize shown in the game (for example, free Melody Fries).

qa.q: When are weekly game prizes picked up or awarded?
qa.a: I don't have those details yet, since prizes are not switched on. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Do I earn points from the game?
qa.a: Not yet. Game points switch on when Melody turns game rewards on. After that, you get 1 point per 100 score, up to 50 game points a day.

qa.q: Are cheaters allowed on the leaderboard?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts don't count.

qa.q: What is the Melody Games Pack?
qa.a: It's Trivia, Sports Trivia, Melody Word (a daily 5-letter word), Melody Mix (word scramble) and Truth or Dare. You can play solo or pass the phone around the table.

qa.q: How does Trivia work?
qa.a: Pick a category and answer timed multiple-choice questions. Faster right answers score more. You can play solo (10 questions) or pass the phone with 2 to 6 players.

qa.q: What is Sports Trivia and the Fan Test?
qa.a: Pick your favorite LA or California team for a 10-question Fan Test and get a 1 to 5 star Fan Rating, or play mixed LA sports questions. You can share your rating.

qa.q: How does Melody Word work?
qa.a: You get one daily 5-letter word, the same for everyone that day. You have 6 guesses and up to 2 hints. A new word comes every day at midnight LA time.

qa.q: How does Melody Mix work?
qa.a: It's a word scramble. Unscramble as many words as you can before time runs out. You get 3 skips.

qa.q: How does Truth or Dare work?
qa.a: It's a table game for 1 to 6 players. Pick Truth or Dare, or Surprise me, for 3 turns each. Dares never involve drinking and anyone can pass. It's just for fun and gives no points.

qa.q: How many points can I earn from the Games Pack?
qa.a: Once game rewards are on: Trivia and Sports Trivia give 1 point per 2 right answers (up to 5 a round), Melody Mix 1 per 2 words (up to 3), and Melody Word 3 points (fewer if you use hints). The Games Pack maxes at 10 points a day.

qa.q: Are game points on right now?
qa.a: Not yet. Game rewards are in BETA, so you can play for fun and bragging rights until Melody switches them on.

qa.q: What is the LA Scoreboard?
qa.a: It shows live scores for LA and California teams, with details, team stats and where to watch. It's for information only and has no streams.

qa.q: What are Who wins picks?
qa.a: They're free picks on LA games, just for fun, with no money or wagers. Picks lock when the game starts. Once game rewards are on, a right pick made before the game starts earns 2 points, up to 6 a day.

qa.q: What is Football Squares?
qa.a: It's a free football game board, one per NFL or college game. Every member can get one free square by tapping Get my free square. Extra squares come with a purchase: show your rewards card and staff add a ticket.

qa.q: How do Football Squares winners get picked?
qa.a: Entries close at kickoff, and then the row and column numbers (0-9) are drawn at random. At the end of Q1, halftime, Q3 and the final, the last digit of each team's score picks the winning square. A purchase doesn't improve the odds of any one square.

qa.q: What are Football Squares prizes?
qa.a: Prizes are set for each board and shown on it before you play: food, merch, % off the check, a free non-alcoholic drink, or % off a drink (21+ with ID). No cash or gift cards. You claim them at Melody with your rewards card.

qa.q: Can I order from my table?
qa.a: Yes. In the app, pick where you're sitting (table number, bar, patio or to go), add items and tap Send my order. If you scanned a table code, your table is already picked.

qa.q: How do I pay?
qa.a: You order on your phone, then pay your server or bartender like normal. You still earn points on every check.

qa.q: What are the table QR codes for?
qa.a: Scanning a table code takes you into the app with your table already picked, so your order goes to the right place.

qa.q: What food is on the menu?
qa.a: The app has Starters, Mac & Cheese, Burgers, Fries, Soups, Tacos & Burritos, plus Taco Tuesday tacos. Tap Menu in the app to browse, and prices are shown.

qa.q: What are the Mac & Cheese options?
qa.a: Lobster ($21.50), Melody Burger ($19.25), Chicken Parmesan ($18.25), Bacon Cheddar & Jalapeno ($17.25), Parmesan & Mushroom ($17.25) and House Mac ($15).

qa.q: What starters do you have?
qa.a: Lemon Pepper Wings ($16), Avocado Toast ($13), BBQ Rib Grilled Cheese Bites ($15), Buttermilk Chicken Strips & Fries ($16), Chicken Pot Stickers ($15), Fried Green Beans ($13), Fried Shrimp ($18.25), Jalapeno Calamari ($16), Lettuce Wraps ($16) and Baby Back Ribs & Fries ($20.25).

qa.q: What is the Melody Burger?
qa.a: It's grilled Angus beef on a pretzel bun with caramelized onions, Gorgonzola, apple-smoked bacon, spinach and BBQ sauce, served with fries, for $19.25.

qa.q: What fries do you have?
qa.a: Gilroy Garlic Fries ($6.75), Melody Fries ($5.75), Onion Strings ($9.75), Phat Fries ($7.75), Philly Cheese Steak Fries ($17.25) and Sweet Potato Fries ($7.75). Add cheese +$2 on Melody Fries and Phat Fries.

qa.q: What soups do you have?
qa.a: French Onion, Tomato Bisque and Black Bean, each in a cup or bowl.

qa.q: What tacos and burritos do you have?
qa.a: Tacos (2 per order): Shrimp, Salmon, Carnitas, Chicken, Avocado and Beyond. Burritos: Carnitas, Steak, Chicken and Bean & Cheese. There are also Nachos and a Cheese Quesadilla.

qa.q: Do you have vegetarian or vegan options?
qa.a: The app shows items like Avocado Toast, Avocado Tacos, Beyond Tacos, Vegan Carnitas Tacos (Tuesdays) and Fried Green Beans. Tell your server about dietary needs.

qa.q: What drinks do you have?
qa.a: The app lists Mango Margarita, House Margarita, Paloma, Old Fashioned, Moscow Mule, Espresso Martini, Long Island, Michelada, Draft Beer, Mimosa, Round of Shots and a Bucket of Beers (5).

qa.q: How much are drinks?
qa.a: The drink prices in the app are previews until Melody signs off, so ask your server for current prices. Margaritas are $6 on Tuesdays and happy hour is 3-6 daily.

qa.q: Can I see real photos of the food?
qa.a: Yes. Some dishes have a real photo tag, like Lemon Pepper Wings, Lobster Mac & Cheese and Mango Margarita. Some also have a spin view.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: The app has 12 languages. Look for the language option in the app.

qa.q: Is there a kid mode?
qa.a: The app has a kid mode that hides adult-only games. Ask staff if you need more details.

qa.q: Do I need to download the app?
qa.a: No download needed. It opens in your phone's browser from the Melody link or table QR code, and you can add it to your Home Screen.

qa.q: Can I add my rewards card to Apple or Google Wallet?
qa.a: Not yet. For now your gold Melody Rewards card lives in the app under My Rewards Card, with your card ID, points and a QR code.

qa.q: What do I do if my points are wrong?
qa.a: Ask your server or a manager, or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: How do I get help from staff?
qa.a: Flag your server or bartender, or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Do you offer delivery?
qa.a: I don't have delivery details in the app. Please call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Can I order to go?
qa.a: Yes. In the app, pick To go when you choose where you're sitting.

qa.q: Do you have a LAX crew discount?
qa.a: I don't have that in the app. Please ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Is my information private?
qa.a: Your exact location stays on your phone, and the app only uses location while it's open. We don't sell or share your data or use it for ads. The restaurant owner and SousShift AI see app opens and visit stats to prevent fraud.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play the games?
qa.a: No. The games are free with or without an account, but you need to join to save points.

qa.q: Who runs the rewards program?
qa.a: Melody Bar & Grill, with the app provided by SousShift AI. Melody can change the program, point values or rewards with notice in the app, and points you've already earned stay in your balance.
